How do I change my name or details?
Go to Profile, then Edit profile. You can change your name and add or remove your mobile number, date of birth and gender.
How do I change my password?
Go to Profile, then Change password. Enter your current password, then your new one. If you sign in with Google, manage your password in your Google account instead.
Can I use dark mode or Nepali?
Yes. Go to Profile, then Appearance. Choose System, Light or Dark for the theme, and English or Nepali for the language.
Your account and profile are stored with Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore). The app never stores your password; Firebase handles sign-in. See the privacy policy for details.
How do I delete my account?
Go to Profile, then Danger zone, and tap Delete account. You\'ll be asked to confirm. This permanently removes your profile and your account.
Where are bookings and health records?
They\'re coming soon. The Bookings and Records tabs will fill in as those features are built.
